units.source_text: 这里是乌丸车库后面的板仓街的一角。

en.t: This was a corner of Itakura Street behind the Karasuma depot.

units.source_text: 电车入库的反响震动着阴沉沉的夜空，

en.t: The reverberations of the streetcars entering the depot shook the gloomy night sky,

units.source_text: 电车进发出的淡紫色的火花划破了夜空。

en.t: and pale purple sparks thrown off by the streetcars cut through the darkness.

units.source_text: 女人从饭仓街向东跑去，沿着后街爬上了坡道。

en.t: The woman ran east from Iikura Street and climbed the slope along a back street.

units.source_text: 我和边哭边走的她默默地并排而行。

en.t: I walked silently beside her as she went on crying.

units.source_text: 良久她才发现我，向我靠近过来。

en.t: Only after a long while did she notice me and draw closer.

units.source_text: 她用因哭泣而嘶哑了的声音，不失礼仪地向我数落了一番柏木的不良行为。

en.t: In a voice hoarse from crying, yet without losing her manners, she recounted Kashiwagi's misconduct to me at some length.
